reason: The rough edge is meant to break the skin and a vessel, so the body needs to encounter it before the bleeding can be stopped.
expectation: The body will get a small cut that exposes the damaged vessel.

effect: The cut is present and the damaged vessel has narrowed; platelets at the cut look like the next step toward stopping the bleeding.
reason: Platelets are cell fragments at the damaged vessel, so I expect them to help form an initial plug.
expectation: Platelets will gather at the damaged vessel and begin limiting the bleeding.

effect: The platelets formed a plug that slows the leak; fibrinogen and activated clotting factors remain to be used.
reaction: The plug makes sense as an initial way to limit bleeding.
reason: The activated clotting factors and fibrinogen are the remaining clotting ingredients. I'm guessing they work together to strengthen the plug.
expectation: The clotting factors will change fibrinogen into material that helps reinforce the platelet plug.

effect: The clotting factors turned fibrinogen into fibrin threads, pictured forming a mesh among platelets.
reaction: The mesh looks like a useful way to reinforce the plug.
reason: The fibrin mesh appears suited to strengthening the platelet plug at the cut.
expectation: The threads will reinforce the platelet plug and stop the bleeding.

effect: The fibrin mesh reinforced the platelet plug and stopped the bleeding, though the skin remains open.
reaction: It was satisfying to see how the threads and plug worked together; I noticed the wound itself still needs to heal.

mostWorthwhile.text: Reinforcing the platelet plug was most worthwhile because it showed how the mesh helps stop the leak, while distinguishing that from closing the skin.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the cut was straightforward but less interesting than seeing the clot form.

surprise.text: I had guessed the clotting factors and fibrinogen worked together, but the result showed the fine threads that form a mesh.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although I was guessing about how the clotting factors and fibrinogen worked together before trying them.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the still-open skin heals after the vessel is sealed; stopping the bleeding feels like only part of the story.
